title: The Shoes Left in the Rain
youtube_title: The Shoes Left in the Rain | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Kindness is helping carry what feels too heavy.
summary: At a cottage porch and the hall just inside, a pair of canvas shoes left out in a gentle rain is awkward for one person. Chioma notices Cousin Pio struggling and takes a useful half of the job without asking to be praised.
